text: GOOOOOAAAAAAAALLL! JOHNSON WITH AN EARLY GOAL FOR SPURS! What a start for the depleted visitors! Tottenham work the ball patiently from side to side, with Kulusevski playing a lovely backheel to Porro on the overlap.

GOOOOOOAAAAAAALLLLLL! SARABIA LEVELS FOR WOLVES! Just as the clock ticks beyond 90 minutes, Wolves finally take a chance! Cunha whips a lovely ball over the Spurs backline for Sarabia, who takes a great touch on his right foot before volleying past Vicario on his left! What a strike! 1-1 at Molineux!

text: GOOOOOOOAAAAAAALLLLL! WOLVES HAVE TURNED IT AROUND! REMARKABLE SCENES AS LEMINA SWEEPS HOME! Doyle's quick free-kick allows Sarabia to burst down the wing, and the substitute cuts inside to swing a low cross into the area.
O'Neil is making another two changes as Wolves desperately chase an equaliser.

narrative_context: sudden late moment with little build-up
text: ALMOST GAME OVER! Spurs break on Wolves and create two chances to kill the contest.
GREAT CHANCE! How many of these are Wolves going to squander?! Toti does brilliantly to bring the ball out of defence, playing a give-and-go with Gomes before finding Ait-Nouri to his left.
Save, but the flag is up! Gomes wins possession on the edge of the Spurs box before slipping a pass in behind for Ait-Nouri, who crashes a low shot against the legs of Vicario.
SAVE! Semedo cuts inside to find Cunha on the break, and the Brazilian offloads to Lemina to his right.

text: CHANCE! Ait-Nouri plays a pass inside to Cunha before flying forward for the return ball.
GREAT DEFENDING! Bellegarde whips an enticing cross into the six-yard box, where Dawson looks destined to nod it home.
OVER! Bellegarde's corner finds Lemina at the back post, and he powers a header over via a deflection off Davies.
He loops a header on target, but Vicario is able to make a comfortable save.
